This is a great game if you want a fun arcade styled third person shooter, that requires strategy, has lots of weapons and enemies. It does have some problems, the graphics are sketchy, the controls are kind of slow, and sometimes you have to deal with boring sections, but most of the time you go straight to action. If you live online you can play with 4 players as well. Watch the videos, and you know what it is about, because it plays exactly as shown.

About this game:
[list]
[*] You fight aliens invaders with 4 classes of fighters. The ranger, wing diver, air raider and fencer, each with it's own playing style, and pros/cons.
[*] It's an arcade styled third person shooter, strategy game, with upgrades. You don't simply shoot enemies, you need elaborate a strategy according to your weapons and level.
[*] Besides weapons you can also use vehicles. They're fun to use and very useful.
[*] You can play online with friends or other players. Up to 4 players.
[/list]

Pros:
[list]
[*] It's a very fun and trace game in lower difficulties. You don't need to think much, just destroy everything around you, and see what's the next alien. You can have some variation with vehicles or by flying with wing diver.
[*] In higher difficulties you need to come up with a strategy. Different enemies have different strengths and weaknesses. The game gives you a lot of liberty to do what you want, but it's still very difficult.
[*] There's a lot of variety of enemies and weapons. It's arcade styled with waves so you end up wanting to see what happens next and what are the next weapons.
[*] It has an interesting story with some plot twists.
[/list]

Cons:
[list]
[*] The graphics could be better. The colors are too saturated, has low polygon density, and textures have low resolution. I understand sacrifices must be made to support to many enemies but could better even with low requirements.
[*] The controls are often cumbersome. Very noticeable with vehicles. The input is very slow in some actions, like turning a robot, or running with ranger, or flying an helicopter. It's specially bad with the giant robot.
[*] Some levels take too much time explaining what's happening. Those intros should be skipped if you already watched.
[*] Leveling up takes a very long time. I assume that's because online is available and the developers expect you to use it.
[*] Not a fan of the English dub, especially the citizens screams. It's too cartoon styled and obnoxious for my taste.
[/list]

Return to the very beginning of the franchise in this reboot/remake of the very first Earth Defense Force game, SIMPLE2000シリーズVol.31 THE 地球防衛軍, known internationally as Monster Attack. From humble beginnings as a civilian working for the EDF to being thrust directly into first contact with aliens who absolutely [i]do not want peace[/i] (that, and they literally feed off our pollution, IDK), you'll become one of the four classic classes, the jack-of-all-trades Ranger, the high-speed precision striker that is the Air Raider, the multi-talented, powered-armor wearing Fencer, and the true backbone of any online EDF game, the Engineer.

Unlike previous entries, this time the enemies take region-based damage. Shoot off the legs of an alien soldier to bring them to a literal crawl, shred alien mecha piece by piece - but don't dawdle. They regenerate.

Also, this time duplicate weapons aren't useless as they automatically combine to make existing weapons more powerful, meaning you're not wasting time when you get the same weapons you already have.

And, of course, the series' signature carnage returns. Tons of enemies to shoot, almost all of which gloriously ragdoll on death, and the environments are fully destructable both to your advantage and disadvantage. That building you were using as cover can be torn down by stray fire - or deliberately by the enemy - but if an enemy's trying to be cheeky and use it to cheese you or otherwise prop up their traps, just tear the thing down, and their best-laid plans will go down with it.
